message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore’s presentation on climate science and policy. |
| **“An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power”** | 2017 | Follow‑up that examines progress (or lack thereof) since the first film. |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels the world to document the impacts of climate change. |
| **“Climate Change: The Facts”** | 2019 | A BBC production that explains the science behind global warming. |
| **“The 11th Hour”** | 2007 | A global perspective on environmental degradation and solutions. |
| **“Our Planet”** (Netflix series) | 2019 | While not solely about climate change, it highlights how warming affects ecosystems worldwide. |

All of these are available on major streaming platforms (Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, or YouTube). Let me know if you’d like more details or recommendations tailored to a specific region or age group!
